name: transition-stack-push-up
title: Page Stack Transition
description: Trang mới trượt từ dưới lên phủ trang cũ, trang cũ lùi lại thu nhỏ 0.94, nhích lên 10 px và tối đi; quay lại thì chạy ngược đúng như vậy.

moworks.author: takayu

options.radius: px of the new page's top corners (50)
options.backAt: s after the start for the exact reverse (null: stay)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio page-transition-stack, written here): Incoming scene slides up from y = 100 % to 0 with rounded top corners (10 px); the outgoing scene stays under it, scales 1 → 0.94 about its centre, rises 10 px and darkens 0 → 45 % (overlay). 720 ms power2.inOut (easeInOutCubic). Back: the exact reverse. Params: duration (0.72 s) · scale (0.94) · rise (10 px) · dim (45 %) · radius (10 px) · ease (power2.inOut).
moworks.titleVi: Trang mới trượt lên phủ trang cũ
